summary.text: Jackie Addison is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 45 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is on the November ballot with fellow incumbent Caylin Young, Democrat Chanel Branch and Green Party candidate Renaud Brown for the district's three seats.

paragraphs.text: Jackie Addison was born in Baltimore and graduated from Dunbar High School in 1980.
According to her legislative biography, she attended Sojourner-Douglass College and studied early childhood education.
Ballotpedia lists Addison as a member of the Baltimore City Democratic State Association and a board member of the Belair Edison Youth Council and the HARBEL Community Association.
Addison assumed office on January 11, 2023, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly website lists her as a member of the Ways and Means Committee.
